text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-An eight-member ministerial committee to discuss the municipal election law after the cabinet withdrew it from parliament last week.
-The national council for the media will not grant new licenses to more television and radio stations.
-Prime Minister Hariri to Moscow to discuss economic and political relations with the Russian leadership.
-A small tremor hit Lebanon at night.
-Citizens are worried about the fate of appeals lodged by defeated candidates against the results of last year's parliamentary elections. The head of the constitutional council resigned last week.
-Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfeir says: the democratic process is being harmed.
